title: onboard_lookup
description: A paired device with the rule setup_devices asks what it is about to set up (paired clients only). Either the values of the scanned QR code (session_id, public_key, hub_id; the device first compared fp of the QR code with its own pin) or the typed code (code; the device checked nothing itself: it trusts its own pinned connection, and the waiting device gets the secret only over its own pinned TLS connection, like with a PIN). A QR mismatch of key or hub id invalidates the session. A code is looked up only among the hub's own open sessions and is used up by the first successful lookup; wrong codes count against x-limits onboard_code_failures_per_device and onboard_code_failures_total (too_many_attempts). Answer: onboard_info or onboard_error. Exactly one way: either code alone or all of session_id, public_key and hub_id (checked by tools/validate.py; the hub answers invalid_request otherwise).
